Specifications.Product name: ACEFAST K2 Pro portable wireless speaker.
Specifications.Feature 1: DSP Processor – Digital Signal Processing technology – rich sound with heavy bass.
Specifications.Feature 2: Supports TWS interconnection for 360° surround stereo sound effect, creating a home theater-level KTV.
Specifications.Feature 3: Supports BT, USB flash drive and AUX playback modes.
